newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: CRICKET-NEW ZEALAND DISMISSED CHEAPLY BY WAQAR AND MUSHTAQ.
newsitem.headline: CRICKET-NEW ZEALAND DISMISSED CHEAPLY BY WAQAR AND MUSHTAQ.

text.p: Paceman Waqar Younis and leg spinner Mushtaq Ahmed took four wickets each as Pakistan bundled out New Zealand for 155 on the opening day of the first Test on Thursday.
Waqar finished with four for 48 and Mushtaq claimed four for 59 to bowl out the visitors in 57.1 overs after New Zealand had won the toss and elected to bat at Lahore's Gaddafi Stadium.
New Zealand, who were 67 for three at lunch, collapsed against the Pakistan seam and spin attack, losing their last seven wickets for 88.
Last-wicket pair Dipak Patel and Simon Doull added some respectability to the total by putting on 38 runs before Patel was trapped lbw by Mushtaq just before tea.
Patel made 26, making him the second highest scorer behind Adam Parore who made 37 batting at number three.
The Pakistani bowlers bowled with great flair despite the absence of captain Wasim Akram who pulled out at the last minute owing to shoulder pain.
